LIST OF ZONES

Lamda

An affluent, carefully maintained Zone known for its garden cities and Art Deco-inspired architecture. Controlled by the healthcare Monolith, Lamda.

Eta

A large coastal Zone known for its beaches, nightlife, entertainment, and relaxed local culture. Controlled by the security Monolith, Palisade.

Rho

A vast, sparsely populated badlands and canyons with a Wild West flavor. Controlled by AquaFlo, the industrial water producing Monolith.
